subject: Service outage — recovery stipend and trial extension for NovaForge
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novaforge.io>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Turner <kyle.turner@novaforge.io>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected 2-hour downtime this morning — impact and ask

Hi Rafael,

We saw a spike in errors and a roughly two-hour outage window this morning (09:03–11:04 PDT) that impacted our inference jobs for NovaForge's ingestion pipeline. Our on-call captured repeated 5xx responses and elevated latency across multiple regions. This caused a backlog of jobs and we had to fail over to a fallback batch process.

We ran our SLA-impact calc and estimate ~18k tokens lost and a material hit to our nightly ETL. Per our contract (SLA Appendix B), we'd like to request a recovery stipend (free credits) to offset the impact and a 30-day trial extension on the dedicated instance we're evaluating so we can validate resiliency.

Can you confirm next steps and timelines for remediation and credits? I've attached a short incident summary and sample logs.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Ops Lead, NovaForge
priya.shah@novaforge.io
(t) +1 415-555-0198

--
attachments: incident_summary_20270621.pdf
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novaforge.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 2-hour downtime this morning — impact and ask

Hi Priya — thanks for flagging and for the incident packet. Sorry you ran into this. We're already looking into the root cause (routing + autoscaler interplay) and I want to own the remediation and the customer recoverables.

Immediate plan:
- I'll follow up with a more detailed RCA by EOD PDT tomorrow.
- For immediate relief, we can offer a provisional token stipend and a 30-day trial extension while we complete the RCA. I need an internal quick-approval for the exact credit amount; I'll loop in ops/finance.

Can you confirm the date range you want the stipend to cover and whether you'd prefer credits applied to your hosted bill or a promo code for your test/dedicated instance?

Rafael
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
--
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 2-hour downtime this morning — impact and ask

Rafael — saw Priya's note. Given NovaForge is in active evaluation for dedicated, I recommend we be somewhat generous to preserve the trial momentum.

Proposal for quick approval:
- Immediate provisional credit: $6,000 (applied as account credit to hosted usage)
- 30-day trial extension for the dedicated evaluation (no extra charge)
- Offer a free dedicated consulting hour to review deployment and failover patterns

Finance: treat as a one-off operational gesture (not a contract amendment). If they escalate to a formal SLA claim after the RCA, we can revisit.

Grace
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
--
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novaforge.io>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 2-hour downtime this morning — recovery stipend and trial extension for NovaForge

Priya — following up with an explicit offer we can enact immediately: 

1) Provisional account credit: $6,000 applied to your hosted account (visible on next billing cycle).
2) 30-day extension on your Dedicated evaluation — we've set this to auto-extend on your trial config; no action needed on your side.
3) One-hour consulting session with our Site Reliability team to review configuration and recommended routing changes.

I've attached a short spreadsheet outlining how we arrived at the credit number (traffic window, token estimate, and goodwill factor). If that's acceptable, I'll get finance to issue the credit and Stephanie will create the promo-code/extend the trial.

If you prefer promo credits instead of account credit, tell me and we'll issue a redeemable code that applies to the dedicated trial.

Best,
Rafael
--
attachments: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novaforge.io>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Turner <kyle.turner@novaforge.io>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 2-hour downtime this morning — recovery stipend and trial extension for NovaForge

Rafael — thank you for the quick turnaround and the proposal. We appreciate the gesture. A couple of small asks: 

- Can the credit be issued as a promo code tied to the dedicated evaluation so we can allocate it specifically to the workload that failed? That helps our finance team reconcile the impact.
- Can we schedule the SR consult for Thursday (06/24) in the morning PST? Kyle and I will attend.

If you can confirm the promo code and the consult time, we'll accept the offer and hold off on formal SLA submission while we review the RCA.

Thanks again — Priya

--
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novaforge.io>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 2-hour downtime this morning — recovery stipend and trial extension for NovaForge

Priya — confirmed. Finalizing items now: 

- Promo code issued: NOVAFORGE-RECOVER-2027 (value $6,000) — applies to your Dedicated evaluation pool only. Code and redemption link: https://billing.redwood.com/redeem/NOVAFORGE-RECOVER-2027
- SR consult scheduled for Thu 2027-06-24 09:30–10:30 PDT. Meeting invite sent to your team.
- Attached: incident_summary_20270621.pdf (from your original), and internal ticket references. We'll send the RCA by EOD 2027-06-22 (ETA met).

Stephanie — please confirm credit issuance in billing and add the promo code to the account. Grace — thanks for the quick signoff.

Rafael
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
--
attachments: incident_summary_20270621.pdf, proposed_credit_calc.xlsx
